findings.detail: The candidate used Popen.communicate() and tested stdout/stderr length only after each stream had been accumulated in memory. The reviewer reported this as capped collection, but an abnormal child could emit unbounded bytes before the retrospective rejection.

recovery: Replace communicate() with concurrent hard-capped stdout/stderr readers and an independent stdin writer; terminate at the byte cap, preserve process timeout and bounded digests, hostile-test the live read cap, then obtain another fresh exact-HEAD veto before any Docker/database contact.
